messages:
frank: Quick sync 1 — new first-run orientation overlay prototype ready for review. It's a lightweight modal that introduces the setup checklist + one-click sample project launcher. Figma: https://figma.redwood/orientation-overlay :mag_right:
elaine: thanks. main concern is friction: do we force users to interact with the checklist or can they skip to the console? we need low friction for demos.
frank: plan is non-blocking. overlay has two primary CTAs: 'Try sample project' and 'Skip for now'. If they skip, we collapse the overlay and pin a small helper chip in the toolbar for 24h.
omar: front-end constraints: if we keep it non-blocking we should avoid focus traps. For keyboard users we do trap focus inside modal while it's open, but allow Esc to dismiss and populate a hidden toast with an undo link so they can reopen. Implementation note: use focus-trap library and ensure body scroll is locked.
lou: a11y notes: trap is fine if announced properly. The modal should have role='dialog' and aria-modal='true', with aria-labelledby pointing to the header and aria-describedby to the checklist summary. Also ensure the dismiss button is reachable as the first tab stop. Toast should use aria-live='assertive' for dismiss confirmation and aria-live='polite' for successful sample deploy.
maria: i18n: the 'Skip for now' label is problematic in some locales (reads as final). Suggest 'Skip and explore' or 'Maybe later' alternatives; check translations for right tone. Also watch line breaks on CTA — some languages will double length.
frank: good catch. Proposed CTAs: Primary: 'Try a sample project' (short) Secondary: 'Skip and explore' (secondary). For compact widths we can collapse primary to icon+label or allow two-line wrap.
elainE: typo in my name; but ok. timeline? can we land copy + a11y fixes by Wednesday? Demo on Friday.
omar: yes. I'll mock the modal animation with reduced motion media query respect. Use CSS prefers-reduced-motion: reduce for users with that setting. Also keeping images lazy and fixed card height to prevent CLS.
lou: contrast: primary CTA needs 4.5:1 at text size; current blue swatch at 12px borderline. Either increase font-size or darken background. Also ensure focus outline is 3px solid with visible contrast, not just shadow. For keyboard users, ensure the 'Try' CTA receives aria-describedby that references a short helper line about billing/trial so the meaning is clear to screen readers.
shirley: legal wants 'trial tokens' phrasing (not 'demo tokens') in public UX. Also note analytics: we should tag which CTA variant is used for the demo to capture conversion. Add data-attr 'data-onboard-v=overlay-v2' to CTAs.
frank: done. I'll update figma copy to 'trial tokens' and add the analytics attribute. Also will include small helper text: 'Trial tokens included 0 free requests 1; billed only after trial removed.' (legal will finalize numbers).
maria: please avoid numeric punctuation that breaks RTL locales; separate number and text using non-breaking spaces.
ci-bot: preview build created (pr/892) 1 netlify: https://preview.redwood/pr-892
frank: thanks @ci-bot 1 I'll run through VoiceOver + NVDA on the preview. Can folks check the toast copy when they launch a sample? Current toast: "Sample launched 1 Open workspace".
lou: prefer: "Sample 'EchoApp' is ready 1 Open workspace" for clarity. And add aria-live='polite' on the toast container so it doesn't interrupt other critical alerts.
omar: implemented aria-live and added small delay before toast appears to avoid double announcements. Also added keyboard shortcut hint in the overlay: 'Press / to open command palette' which should be localized.
frank: final asks: freeze copy by Tue EOD so we can ship the stripped demo on Thu. Thanks everyone :rocket:
